chapter: Virginia school and first Washington bands
title: Bricklaying at school and leaving for Washington
summary: He studied bricklaying at school, played on the side, and left for Washington where he began playing in bands.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: I'd work little odd jobs not actually playing music. But in school I took up bricklaying. And so, a guy -- my instructor was from Richmond, Pappa Joe. I don't remember his last name, but anyway, he'd get little jobs for some of us around Richmond. And this was how we picked up a few dollars.

But I'd play a little bit on the side, you know, and I'd go back to school. So, I left this school in '29 and I went to Washington because some guys from the school -- that's when I really started playing in a lot of bands around Washington.
